V. 4. 74</ls>; <ls>Śi. 12. 2</ls>, <ls n="Śi.">18. 7</ls>; ज्योतिश्चक्राक्षदण्डः <ls>Dk. 1</ls> Axle-pole. .²2 The pole of a cart. .²3 A cart, car; also a wheel. .²4 The beam of a balance. .²5 Terrestrial latitude. .²6 A die for playing with; cube; यानाक्षमधिकृत्य ब्रूत इति गम्यते न तु विदेवनाक्षमिति . <ls>ŚB. on MS. 6. 8. 35</ls>. .²7 The seed of which rosaries are made. .²8 A weight equal to 16 māṣas and called कर्ष. .²9 <ab>N.</ab> of the plant Terminalia Belerica (विभीतक- <lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>बेहडा</ns>) the seed of which is used as a die; also the nut of this plant; यथा वै द्वे वामलके द्वे वा कोले द्वौ वाक्षौ मुष्टिरनुभवति <ls>Ch. Up.</ls>; so धाराभिरक्षमात्राभिः. .²10 A shrub producing the rosary seed, Eleocarpus Ganitrus (रुद्राक्ष); the seed of this plant, as also of another plant (इन्द्राक्ष). .²11 A serpent; hence a curve. .²12 Garuḍa. .²13 <ab>N.</ab> of a son of Rāvaṇa. .²14 The soul. .²15 Knowledge (usually, sacred). .²16 Law; a lawsuit; legal procedure. .²17 A person born blind. .²18 The lower part of the temples (कर्णनेत्रयोर्मध्ये शङ्खादधोभागः). .²19 The base of a column; अथवाक्षं नवांशोच्चं जन्म चैकेन कारयेत् . <ls>Māna. 14. 17</ls>. .²20 The window-like part of a swing, a hammock, a palanquin, an axle of a chariot; पार्श्वयोर्वारणं कुर्यात् तस्याधोऽक्षं सुसंयुतम् . <ls>Māna. 50. 165</ls>, <ls n="Māna.">166. 21</ls> Gambling (in general). <ab>cf.</ab> अक्षो द्यूते वरूथाङ्गे नयवादौ बिभीतके . कर्षे व्याप्तौ कृषे (?) चक्रे आधारव्यवहारयोः . आत्मजे पाशके दैत्यभेदे चेन्द्रियवालयोः . <ls>Nm.</ls> .{@-क्षम्@} (अश्नुते व्याप्नोति विषयान् स्ववृत्त्या संयोगेन वा) .²1 An organ of sense; निरोधाच्चेतसोऽक्षाणि निरुद्धान्यखिलान्यपि <ls>Pt. 2. 154</ls>; संयताक्षो विनीतः <ls>Mātaṅga L. 12. 1</ls>. (The word संयताक्ष here means ‘having control over his senses’, but ‘having eyes closed’ <ls>MW.</ls>); {%m.%} also नियच्छेद्विषयेभ्योऽक्षान् <ls>Bhāg.</ls>; an object of sense. .²2 The eye, (only at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>; जलजाक्ष, कमलाक्ष, <ab>&c.</ab>) .²3 Sachal salt, sea-salt. .²4 Blue vitriol (from its crystallized shape) (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>मोरचूद</ns>) [<ab>cf.</ab> <lang>L.</lang> {%axis%}; <lang>Gr.</lang> {%akshon%} or {%axon%}, <lang>Old Germ.</lang> {%ahsa%}; <lang>Germ.</lang> {%achse%}.]
